section.name: Installation
section.p: Configure the private key for the signature in the file webapp/WEB-INF/conf/plugins/workflow-rest.properties :
A client signs a call with two headers :

div.pre: Lutece-Request-Timestamp: <epoch in milliseconds> Lutece-Request-Signature: sha1( <private key> + <timestamp> )

section.p: The signature is lowercase hexadecimal. signatureElements is empty, as it was in v7, so the signature covers the private key and the timestamp only and binds to no request content. Filling it in would change what every existing client has to sign.

The check can be turned off with workflow-rest.security.activated=false in the same file, which serves every call unchecked, doAction included. It exists so the test JSP can be driven locally ; leave it on otherwise.

The check is bound to the module's four resource classes : WorkflowRest, StateRest, ActionRest and ResourceWorkflowRest. A resource class added later without that binding is served unauthenticated, and nothing in the build reports it.
